source.name: The Heart of Racing - team homepage
source.quote: Together with Aston Martin, The Heart of Racing competes around the world in the FIA World Endurance Championship, IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship, and IMSA Michelin Pilot Challenge.
source.note: Manufacturer support partner. Aston Martin wings logo on the fire-suit chest and hood; ASTON MARTIN RACING banner on the windshield of cars #23 and #27.

source.name: The Heart of Racing - team homepage
source.quote: Beyond the track, we race for something bigger—supporting the life-changing work of Seattle Children’s.
source.note: Charity beneficiary: Seattle Children's name and heart logo on the rear wing of cars #23 and #27 (seen at the 2026 Lone Star Le Mans); donations raised for the hospital.

source.name: FIA WEC - Goodyear extends LMGT3 tyre partnership with long-term commitment
source.quote: ensuring it will continue to provide tyres to the series’ fiercely competitive LMGT3 category until at least 2029
source.note: Goodyear is the championship's exclusive LMGT3 tyre supplier; its logos appear on the cars' tyres and bodywork and on driver suits.

source.name: DHL InMotion - FIA World Endurance Championship partnership page
source.quote: As Official Logistics Partner of the FIA WEC, we deliver more than cargo – we set the stage for world-class endurance racing.
source.note: DHL branding appears on the car number panel, a championship-wide placement for every WEC car.

summary: 2026 FIA WEC season: Aston Martin Vantage LMGT3, cars #23 and #27. The team name (The Heart of Racing) sits across the suit chest and the car sides; the only other branding is the Aston Martin wings/Aston Martin Racing windshield banner (manufacturer partner), Seattle Children's on the rear wing (the team's charity beneficiary), plus championship-supplied Goodyear (exclusive LMGT3 tyre partner) and DHL (number-panel logistics partner). No commercial sponsor on the suit chest or car side.
